In the framework of its activities at the Guiana Space Center (CSG), CNES must Renovation and compliance fuel storage based in the Salvation Islands.

The Renovation and compliance fuel storage which is the subject of this pre-publication, must have the following equipment to perform its main functions:

Removal of the existing installation.
Simplification and securing of the storage area.
Replacement of tanks with “plug and play” tanks.
The new installations must be compatible with a salty environment.
The new installation design must compliant with the French regulation : "Monuments Historiques".
Final commissioning include a full compliance audit and certification.

Project Shine involves the installation of the following: • Wet fuel handling system of which the main component are: • Walking floor system • Various conveyors • Screens + Hoppers • Dry Fuel handling system of which the main components are: • Edge trim + dust silo • Blowers • Ducting and diverters • Energy plant of which the main components are: • Walking floor system for biomass fuel • Main 56MW biomass furnace • Thermal Oil Heating + pumping • Electrostatic Precipitator • Steam Generator • Associated ID fans: recirculation, primary + secondary. • MDF dryers of which the main components are: • Hot Gas Duct • Face Dryer • Core Dryer • Associated fans • Services + utilities to the above, mainly: • Thermal oil • Compressed air • Process Water • Fire detection + suppression • Natural Gas • Steam • Storm and foul water • Bunds where necessary The main requirements of the PSCS Services are outlined below • Organise effective co-operation, co-ordination + communication between contractors, sub-contractors + client through daily whiteboard, weekly + monthly meetings • Liaise with the various vendors/contractors, identify hazards arising from the construction or from the technical, organisational, planning or time related aspects of the project. Review of proposed equipment layouts and vendor tender documents for necessary health + safety requirements. Make recommendations to client + contractors. • Where possible, eliminate the hazards or reduce the risks through consultation + co-operation of and between contractors and client. Identify interdependencies and possible clashes between various vendor packages so they can be resolved in a timely manner. • Communicate necessary control measures, design assumptions or remaining risks to the contractors so they can be dealt with. • Review Vendor Proposals for compliance with EU Machinery Directive + ATEX requirements. • Ensure all HAZOP recommendations are implemented. • Review Building design layout for compliance with relevant safety regulations and best. (BCAR etc.) • Complete AF2 forms and all other necessary notices + communications to H.S.A. • Complete the Health + Safety Plan (including traffic management plan, walkways, construction compound, laydown areas). • Appoint a safety adviser where there are more than 100 personnel on site • Provide all necessary Safety File information to the PSDP. • Ensure there is adequate Welfare facilities for number of personnel. • Manage the segregation and restricted entry to the construction site • Responsible for Inductions • Maintain registers + records for: • Training files • Safe pass • CSCS • Harness training • First aid • PAT equipment • GA1 Report of Thorough Examination • GA2 Weekly Examination of Lifting Equipment • GA3 Work Equipment for Working at Height • Accidents + incidents • Dangerous Occurrences • Toolbox talks • Relevant topics to be covered • Records • Evacuation drills • Safety equipment inspections i.e. harness • Issue + close Permit to Works not limited to; •
